1.consolidated_definition: drog. Consumo habitual y desmedido de narcóticos. Calco de estructura, usual. DRAE 2001, del inglés. Por eso nos hemos tenido que enfrentar al hecho tan dramático de que Puerto Rico aparezca entre los primeros países en tasa de criminalidad, desempleo, drogadicción, alcoholismo, contaminación ambiental, emigración, enfermedades mentales, divorcios, consumo conspicuo, propaganda desenfrenada, desperdicio energético, accidentes de tránsito, esterilización masiva y distribución desigual de las riquezas
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Substance abuse characterized by habitual and excessive consumption of narcotics.

Calque from structure, usual. (From DRAE 2001, derived from English.)

Note: 

- "Drog." is an abbreviation for "droga" which translates to "substance" or "drug".
- "Consumo conspicuo" translates to "conspicuous consumption", a term used in sociology and economics to describe the overindulgence in luxury goods and services.
- "Propaganda desenfrenada" translates to "unbridled propaganda", emphasizing the excessive and uncontrolled nature of the information being disseminated.
- "Distribución desigual de las riquezas" translates to "unequal distribution of wealth", highlighting the disparities in economic resources.
